name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: A scholarship scheme for eligible students subject to the applicable merit, income and school-level conditions.
benefits: Rs 12,000 per year (Rs 1,000 per month) for up to four years, Class IX to XII, subject to scheme rules.
eligibility: Selected through the State/UT Class VIII selection test within the State/UT quota.
Parental income from all sources not more than Rs 3,50,000 per year.
Regular student in a Government, Government-aided or local body school (not Kendriya Vidyalaya, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, residential or private schools).
At least 55% marks in Class VIII (50% for SC/ST students) and clear promotion to Class IX.

all_of.description: The student must have been selected through the State/UT Class VIII selection test (MAT and SAT) within the State/UT quota.
Parental income from all sources must not exceed Rs 3,50,000 per year at the time of selection.

The student must study as a regular student in a Government, Government-aided or local body school. Kendriya Vidyalayas, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, residential schools with boarding and private schools are not eligible.

any_of.description: The student must have scored at least 55% (or equivalent grade) in the Class VIII examination.

all_of.description: SC/ST students get a 5% relaxation on the Class VIII marks requirement.
SC/ST students must have scored at least 50% in the Class VIII examination.
The student must have been cleanly promoted from Class VIII to Class IX to start the scholarship.

eligibility_rules.verification_note: Rules encoded from the NMMSS Revised Guidelines (dsel.education.gov.in), clauses 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.2, 6.1, for a student STARTING the scholarship in Class IX. NSP shows the scheme open for 2026-27. Not modelled: State/UT reservation and quota norms, and continuation rules (60% in Class X, clear promotion in Classes X and XII). Guideline clause 4.1 (only one central scholarship) is not encoded because NSP's 2026-27 notice allows one merit-based scheme plus welfare-based schemes. Re-check the guidelines and the NSP scheme page every academic year.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: A central government income-support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families, subject to scheme rules and exclusions.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments, subject to eligibility and scheme rules.
eligibility: Applicant must meet the scheme's applicable landholding farmer-family criteria.
The farmer family must satisfy applicable exclusion and verification requirements.

all_of.description: The farmer family must own cultivable land recorded in the State/UT land records (held on 1 February 2019, or inherited after the owner's death).
Families with a former or present holder of a constitutional post are not eligible.
Families with a former or present minister, MP, MLA, MLC, mayor of a municipal corporation or district panchayat chairperson are not eligible.
Families with a serving or retired government, PSE or autonomous-body officer or employee, or a regular local-body employee, are not eligible (Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D are excepted).
Families with a retired pensioner drawing Rs 10,000 or more per month are not eligible (Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D are excepted).
Families in which anyone paid income tax in the last assessment year are not eligible.
Families with a practising registered professional (doctor, engineer, lawyer, chartered accountant or architect) are not eligible.
New applicants whose family is Non-Resident Indian under the Income Tax Act are not eligible.

eligibility_rules.verification_note: Rules encoded from the PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines (revised as on 29.03.2020), clauses 3, 4.1, 4.1(c), 5.2-5.3. Before setting rules_complete to true: check the portal's 'Amendment in Operational Guidelines' and 'Clarification' pages for changes after 29.03.2020, and review data/eligibility_verification.md. eKYC, Aadhaar and bank-account requirements are registration steps, not modelled here.
